prompt: Parse javac diagnostic lines such as "Foo.java:12: error: cannot find symbol" into Diagnostic records. Complete JavacErrorParser, then run the tests.
explanation: Reading compiler output is a parsing job: locate the structural separators, validate each field, and only then build the value. Chained indexOf(':', from) calls find the first three colons without splitting the message apart, which matters because a javac message often contains colons of its own. Returning null for anything that does not fit lets countErrors and firstError reuse parse and simply skip the lines that are not diagnostics.
hints: Find the colons one at a time with indexOf(':', startIndex) instead of using split, so the message keeps its own colons.
Validate before you build: check that the file part has no space, that the middle part is all digits, and that the kind is one of the three allowed words.
countErrors and firstError should both call parse and ignore the nulls -- do not repeat the parsing logic.
